issues: 没有导出时长常量，工作台按 md 猜成 30f，只剩开拍前的静置铺垫，三拍一拍都没演
场是纯色平涂，换色只是整屏换一个色块，没有光与空间
胶囊是平涂色块 + 通用黑阴影，像贴图换色，没有材质
非选中词统一 34% 白，列表没有远近层次；上方空无一词，构图上半屏空
字体回退 Helvetica，800 字重 + 固定字距，大字发闷
changes: 补 BEAT_STEP_LIST_THEME_CYCLE_DURATION = 110（铺垫 30f + 3 拍 × 18f + 末拍后 hold 38f），拍长 18f / 跳变窗 6f / 指数 3.2 不变
场加胶囊同色相的径向柔光晕 + 暗角 0.42 + 9% soft-light 颗粒，光晕与底色共用同一个 tInBeat 换色，落位瞬间辉光略涨
胶囊改上亮下暗微渐变 + 顶部 1px 内高光 + 同色辉光阴影；squash 1.12→0.97→1 保留
列表上下各垫两行词，非选中词按离中心行距做透明度 40%→6% 与字号 −4.5%/行 衰减（滚轮式景深）
拍头跳变挂按速度计算的竖向运动模糊（SpeedBlur，静置帧不挂滤镜）；字体换系统栈 700 字重 + 随字号负字距
issuesEn: No exported duration, so the workbench guessed 30f from the card; only the pre-beat hold rendered and none of the three beats played
The field was a flat fill, so each theme change just swapped one colour block for another with no light or depth
The pill was a flat colour with a generic black shadow, reading as a recoloured sticker with no material
All unselected words sat at a uniform 34% white with no depth, and nothing above the pill left the top half empty
Font fell back to Helvetica at weight 800 with fixed tracking, making the big words look heavy
changesEn: Added BEAT_STEP_LIST_THEME_CYCLE_DURATION = 110 (30f lead-in + 3 beats × 18f + 38f hold); beat length 18f, 6f jump window and exponent 3.2 unchanged
The field gets a radial glow in the pill's hue, a 0.42 vignette and 9% soft-light grain; glow and background share the same tInBeat clock, and the glow swells briefly on each landing
Pill now has a top-light / bottom-dark gradient, a 1px inner top highlight and a same-hue glow shadow; the 1.12→0.97→1 squash is kept
Two extra words pad the list above and below; unselected words fade 40%→6% in opacity and shrink 4.5% per row with distance from centre, like a picker wheel
The jump at each beat gets velocity-based vertical motion blur (SpeedBlur, no filter on resting frames); type switched to the system stack at weight 700 with size-based negative tracking
